name: Security Center
description: Per-site ModSecurity OWASP CRS and CrowdSec security management

permission_reasons.http.privileged: Require an interactive administrator with a verified secure session.
permission_reasons.lifecycle.deactivate: Detach local WAF and CrowdSec enforcement before disable or uninstall.
permission_reasons.nginx.transaction: Apply per-site policies with atomic rollback, validation and reload.
permission_reasons.cluster.sync: Synchronize policies only with configured paired site peers.
permission_reasons.network: Read configured Loki events and communicate with the configured CrowdSec engine.
permission_reasons.nginx.config.read: Inspect existing Nginx security topology and adopt marked legacy settings.
